reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that notifies users when turns finish or approval and question events await input, using browser, host-system, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and generic webhook channels.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 回合结束或等待用户确认时，通过浏览器、系统通知及多种 Webhook 渠道发送提醒的消息通知插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness notification plugin that alerts users on turn completion or pending confirmation through browser, system, and configurable webhook channels.

capabilities: Sends event-based messages to Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and configurable webhooks
Provides a settings page and test-message endpoints
Stores notification configuration, webhook URLs, headers, and signing secrets locally
